name: 豬肉蛋花湯 (Zhūròu Dànhuā Tāng) · Egg Drop Soup with Ground Pork
englishName: Egg Drop Soup with Ground Pork
description: A light, silky Chinese home-style soup: seasoned ground pork poached in ginger-scented chicken stock, lightly thickened, with ribbons of egg drizzled in at the end. 15 minutes. Serves 4.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water

steps.text: Mix 150 g ground pork with 1 tsp soy sauce (for the pork), 1/2 tsp cornstarch (for the pork) and 1 tsp Shaoxing wine.
Bring 1.2 L chicken stock and 3 slices ginger to a boil. Drop in the pork in small pinches and simmer 3 minutes, skimming any foam, until cooked through.
Stir 2 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water and drizzle it in while stirring. Simmer 30 seconds, until slightly thickened. Season with 1/2 tsp salt, to taste and 1/4 tsp ground white pepper.
Turn the heat to low. Stir the soup slowly in one direction and pour 3 eggs, beaten in a thin stream from high up, so they set into ribbons. Leave 10 seconds before stirring again.
Turn off the heat, add 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 scallions, thinly sliced, and serve.

notes: Thickening the soup before adding the egg is what suspends the ribbons rather than letting them sink into clumps. For 番茄蛋花湯 (tomato egg drop), add 2 diced tomatoes with the pork; for a silken tofu version, add 200 g cubed tofu after the pork.
